title: Writing on Ellington's request: Turquoise Cloud and the preacher scene
summary: Ellington asked for items such as Turquoise Cloud and a film sequence where the trombone preached; publication details unknown.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Did Duke ever ask you to write numbers? Did he ask you for music, or did you just write music because you wanted to, and play it, and -- or offer it to him? How did it work?

Well, most of the time it was just a sort of a suggestion. Sometimes he would say -- usually give me something to go in here, or give me a number for this section, or give me this, or give me that. And then you would

just dig back in your mind and come up with a little ditty or something that had the feeling that he expected. I remember he asked -- give me something like "Mood Indigo", something soft for some occasion that was coming up. So, I wrote 'Turquoise Cloud.' And then there was the case where the band was in a moving picture.

And I don't remember what picture it was. Anyway, there was a scene, a [hall] whole scene, where this trombone was standing up sort of like a preacher, preaching, you know, a sermon. And give me something to go in there he said. So, I knew all that kind of stuff anyway. So, I wrote this whole thing. And they -- I would play a few bars, and this group out on the floor would say yeah, and then I'd blow a few more bars, and they'd say again yeah -- like a preacher --
-- and then I would resolve into this melody or cadence section. And it would bring -- lead the band into the next piece that they were going to play. And I haven't got paid for that yet (laughs).
When these turns things were published, did they usually get published through Duke's company Tempo?

I guess so. They disappeared. I didn't -- I didn't -- that wasn't a tune anyway that I was speaking of then. That was just -- I don't know what you would call that -- interlude or some sort of suggestive theme.
-- they probably -- did they go through Tempo?
They used to have connections with several publishing companies and I never paid any attention to who they came through.
But he also said to other members of the band, people like Johnny, would he say -- would he say to him, give me a tune or --
Oh, yes. Yes. Yes, Johnny gave many tunes.
